messages:
Sam: Quick check-in after BR-2026 postmortem — we need confirmed owners + firm dates for follow-ups (auto-rollback, flag containment templates, telemetry gating, ops quarantine). Please confirm.
Maya: I'll take auto-rollback design + runtime PR. Will include test matrix and fallback rules. Target: 2026-04-01. ACTION-501.
Connor: I'll draft containment templates + defaults for high-throughput services (caps + region scopes). Target: 2026-04-08. ACTION-502.
Priya: Telemetry gating + runbook hooks for rollouts. Propose min_sample=100, and will add dashboard + alert playbook. Target: 2026-04-05. ACTION-503.
Alex: Ops will implement quarantine timer (3m auto-pause) and an Ops dashboard for quick triage. Also add manual resume button. Target: 2026-03-31. ACTION-504.
ops-bot: Created INF-812: br2026-followups (linked BR-2026).
Maya: Proposed runtime config snippet for discussion:
```json
{
  "autoRollback": true,
  "error_threshold_pct": 4,
  "rolling_window_sec": 120,
  "min_sample": 100,
  "fallback": "redwood-safe-v1"
}
```
Connor: Containment template example: `scope: {percent_users: 5, regions: ["eu-central-1"]}, limits: {max_qps: 500, max_concurrent: 200}`. Will include toggles for rapid shrink/growth.
Priya: Telemetry gating rules (preliminary):
- error_rate > 3% for window AND min_sample >= 100
- p50 latency increase > 25% AND min_sample >= 100
These both should be able to trigger auto-rollback but also surface as high-priority alerts.
Sam: Good. Please create PRs that reference the postmortem tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortem/BR-2026?action-tracker and include rollback test plans.
Maya: PR opened, adding reviewers @Priya @Sam.
Connor: Draft templates in a branch, will ping for review Tuesday.
Alex: Ops sync scheduled Thu 09:15 to validate dashboard signals and quarantine behavior. Invite sent.
Priya: I'll add runbook steps and a smoke test harness to the tests repo.
Sam: Thanks. I'll verify closure after PR merges and update the recurring-incident checklist. Check-in scheduled 2026-04-09. :thumbsup:
